meanings.note: Prefix 'рас-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'сказывать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'tells', paired with 'рассказать'.

examples.trans: Valya, be quiet, do not tell them anything!

examples.text: Ну, рассказывай!
examples.trans: Well, tell me everything!

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нимать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'understand', paired with 'понять'.

examples.text: Я тебя понимаю, у меня дочь такого же возраста.
